UserProgress.title: UserProgress
UserProgress.description: Tracks daily AI mastery progression, streak, XP, quiz accuracy, and 24-hour unlock schedule for an authenticated user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the user.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the profile header.

currentDay.description: Current active day number unlocked for the user (starting at 1).

highestCompletedDay.description: Highest day number completed by the user.

correctAnswers.description: Total number of correctly answered quiz questions.

totalAnswers.description: Total number of answered quiz questions.

nextUnlockEpochMs.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the next daily lesson unlocks.

yesterdayQuizPassedForDay.description: Day number whose prerequisite review quiz from the previous day has been passed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on each update.

LessonRecord.title: LessonRecord
LessonRecord.description: Stores a daily lesson, cached Deep Dive explanation, daily review question, or Day-7 weekly consolidated assessment.

topic.description: Title of the lesson or weekly assessment.

category.description: Topic category badge such as NETWORKING, PROXY, SECURITY, MCP, or ASSESSMENT.

content.description: Structured educational content for the lesson.

question.description: Daily check-in review question based on this lesson.

options.description: Answer choices for the daily question.

correctAnswerIndex.description: Zero-based index of the correct answer option.

explanation.description: Explanation displayed after answering the quiz.

deepDiveContent.description: Extended AI-generated Deep Dive technical breakdown with architecture and code examples.

weeklyAssessment.description: True when this day is a 7th-day consolidated weekly assessment.

weeklyQuestions.description: List of consolidated assessment questions for every 7th day.

xpReward.description: XP awarded upon completing this day.

completed.description: Whether the user has completed this day.

quizScore.description: Score achieved on the assessment or quiz.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on each update.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user learning progress and streak document isolated by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/lessons/{lessonId}.description: Per-user daily lessons, cached Deep Dive expansions, and Day-7 weekly assessments.
